mainEntity.name: What is the average cost per square foot for luxury home construction in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost per square foot for luxury home construction in Los Angeles can vary widely, typically ranging from $400 to over $1,000, depending on several factors. These include the quality of finishes, complexity of architectural design, extent of smart home integration, site challenges, and specific custom features. Urban Outdoor Luxury focuses on providing transparent estimates and works closely with clients to align project scope with budget expectations, ensuring value without compromising quality.
